methodology: Property-specific and regime-specific tolerances based on algebraic vs iterative conditioning and thermodynamic sensitivity

temperature.rationale: Newton-bisection iteration converges to rtol <= 1e-8. Tested with independent start points >=20% away.

pressure.rationale: Exact input for HP/SP. For UV/SV, calculated from ideal-gas state equation P = rho * R * T.

density.rationale: Inverted via specific volume in UV/SV, or computed from equation of state in HP/SP.

enthalpy.rationale: Direct target in setState_HP; computed from converged T and polynomial coefficients.

int_energy.rationale: Direct target in setState_UV; related to h by u = h - P*v.

entropy.rationale: Direct target in setState_SP and setState_SV; logarithmic T-dependence.

cv.rationale: Algebraic evaluation: cv = cp - R/W for ideal gas mixtures.

wave2.name: Cubic Non-Ideal State and Root Solvers
wave2.solver_family: Analytical Cardano / Trigonometric Cubic Root Solver with Phase Selection

nominal.rationale: Analytical cubic root solve in single-phase and stable vapor/liquid branches.

near_spinodal.rationale: Near spinodal or critical points where cubic discriminant approaches zero.

molar_volume.rationale: Inverse relation to density v = W / rho.

enthalpy.rationale: Departure function integration over non-ideal cubic equation of state.

int_energy.rationale: Departure function internal energy u = h - P*v.

entropy.rationale: Logarithmic volume integration plus ideal gas standard state.

cp.rationale: Analytical temperature derivative of enthalpy departure.

cv.rationale: Analytical temperature derivative of internal energy departure.

wave3.name: TPX Pure-Fluid Equations of State
wave3.solver_family: Helmholtz Free Energy Residual & Multidimensional Pair Inversions

temperature.rationale: Independent state variable in forward evaluation.

pressure.rationale: BWR/Helmholtz algebraic pressure evaluation; observed max rel err 9.30e-7.

density.rationale: Iterative 1D root solve for rho given (T, P); observed max rel err 1.13e-6.

enthalpy.rationale: Helmholtz energy residual plus reference offsets; observed max rel err 1.89e-7.

cp.rationale: Second derivative of Helmholtz energy in single-phase region.

cv.rationale: Second temperature derivative of Helmholtz energy in single-phase region.

temperature.rationale: Nonlinear iterative saturation temperature solve T = Tsat(P) from vapor pressure curve.

density.rationale: Mixture two-phase density from saturated liquid/vapor densities and vapor fraction.

enthalpy.rationale: Mixture two-phase enthalpy from saturated liquid/vapor values.

entropy.rationale: Mixture two-phase entropy from saturated liquid/vapor values.
